authors: Zhou, X., Peng, X., Xie, T., et al.

main_contribution: Provides TrainTicket benchmark and surveys industry practices for microservice debugging

authors: Basiri, A., Behnam, N., de Rooij, R., et al.
title: Chaos Engineering

limitation_relevant_to_our_work: Random injection rather than targeted structural topology evaluation

title: MS-Rank: Multi-Metric and Self-Adaptive Root Cause Diagnosis for Microservice Applications
main_contribution: Uses random walk (PageRank variant) on metric graphs for root cause localization
limitation_relevant_to_our_work: Reactive diagnostic model rather than proactive fault impact prediction

title: Microhealer: Automatic Root Cause Localization and Mitigation for Microservices
main_contribution: Graph-based correlation of metrics for automated healing
limitation_relevant_to_our_work: Does not assess how structural topology generalizes across architectures

title: An open-source benchmark suite for microservices and their hardware-software implications for cloud and edge systems

title: Predicting Defects for Eclipse

limitation_relevant_to_our_work: Static code level, completely misses runtime distributed system dynamics

authors: Chen, Y., Jiang, Y., Luo, Y.

title: Empirical exploration of centrality metrics against fault injection outcomes in microservices
